description: This Java class defines an Android Fragment (EntryListFragment) that displays a list of Atom feed entries stored in a local database, manages sync status, and handles user interactions such as refresh and item clicks to open URLs.

classes.name: EntryListFragment
classes.description: An Android ListFragment that displays a list of feed entries, manages sync status, and handles user interactions.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the fragment and enables options menu.

methods.name: onViewCreated
methods.description: Sets up the list adapter, view binder, and initializes loader.

methods.name: onCreateLoader
methods.description: Creates a CursorLoader to query feed entries.

methods.name: onLoadFinished
methods.description: Updates adapter with new cursor data.

methods.name: onListItemClick
methods.description: Opens selected feed entry URL in browser.

methods.name: setRefreshActionButtonState
methods.description: Updates refresh button UI based on sync status.

methods.name: mSyncStatusObserver
methods.description: Callback for observing sync status changes, updates UI accordingly.
